name: Grantly Bell
source:
Often gets into trouble because of his quick temper, but he also has a kind side of him that treasures his friends. Being from the city, he is a great source of information for the country-born Argo.

Likes: Exercise, swords, horseback riding.
Dislikes: Studying, baths, sitting still.

[Taken from [url=http://kaiju09.com/knights_college/english/]official character profile[/url].]
